# axm_webhook (List Resource)

Searches Apple Business Manager webhooks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "axm_webhook" "enabled_webhooks" {
  provider = axm

  config {
    enabled = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Filters results by whether the webhook is enabled.
- `event_type` (String) Filters results to webhooks subscribed to this event type.
- `name` (String) Filters results by a case-insensitive exact webhook name.
